_comment: Ordered dispatch queue for everything not yet done. `after` names dispatch slugs (from dispatch.json) or queue ids that must land first. `conflicts` names slugs whose files overlap — do not run both at once. Six concurrent agents is the ceiling: four agents plus the orchestrator hit the session limit twice on 2026-09-06, and the cap is usage, not wall-clock.

units.title: Port three orphaned pre-roadmap branches, then finish the labwc/Floating validation matrix
units.note: fix/labwc-desktop-parity (10 commits), fix/popup-first-open-and-media-keys (5), fix/screenshot-off-hyprland (2) were never merged to main and are not in roadmap/v2.2. They branched around PR #4 in August; P0-016..025 have since rewritten Bar, status, popups and labwc. Port PER COMMIT, asking whether each bug still exists on the tip. List the superseded ones.

units.title: Remote Control privilege policy and lock-state policy, wired end to end
units.note: Both are already implemented on task/p0-013-request-origin and land as `partial`. P0-014's remainder is a real FIDO/WebAuthn path behind --origin-policy remote. P0-015's remainder is that nothing reports lock state: APEX Shell locks with ext-session-lock and never calls SetLockedHint, so logind reports LockedHint=no on a session locked for an hour. The shell half was recovered from a WIP snapshot and pushed as fix/locked-hint at 87c84f3 (LockedHintService.qml, qmldir, Lockscreen.qml wiring) — integrate that first. P0-015 criterion 2 also needs P0-007's session grants to exist. P0-005's agent also produced an apex-shell branch, task/p0-005-agent-center-modes (the row shows the mode an agent is in) — integrate it alongside the apex-os side.

units.title: MCP auth helper integration and per-MCP sidecar sandboxing
units.note: Depends on the credential broker landing. Sidecar sandboxing should reuse the bubblewrap profile work from P0-009 rather than inventing a second one.

units.note: Policy, helper, unit, catalogue and suite all landed on roadmap/v2.2. Partial because nothing has loaded it on a real machine and the exception sets have never been applied against a live ruleset. Needs a katana run: load it, verify ssh survives, verify apex firewall allow/deny move a real port.

units.title: Redesign Blueprint as a guided experience, redesign Gaming settings around understandable toggles
units.note: Both are settings pages and must obey the P0-023 vocabulary: four states (live/staged/applied/saved), four verbs (Apply/Save/Revert/Reset). settings-semantics.js will fail them otherwise.

units.note: Gates the entire eight-task Android chain. The protocol decision here is the single highest-leverage design left in the roadmap.

units.note: No Android repo exists yet — creating it is part of P1-053. Decide the toolchain and whether it builds on katana before writing any UI.

units.title: Close the eight BASE preservation items still marked partial
units.note: These assert that v2.2 did not regress what v2.1 shipped. Each needs an actual check that the preserved thing still works, not a reading of the code.

units.note: Accessibility is a real audit against a screen reader and keyboard-only navigation, not a sweep for missing labels.

Multi-user/guest/kiosk, APEX Online Accounts, guaranteed safe graphics failover, Fleet architecture
TPM and recovery qualification, then LUKS2 by default and TPM auto-unlock where safe
units.note: L-002 and L-003 are blocked on L-001 and must stay blocked until a real TPM enrol-and-recover cycle has been done on hardware. Turning on full-disk encryption by default without a proven recovery path is how a user loses everything.

units.title: Qualify the integrated image on real hardware, then merge to main
units.note: The last unit. Build the integrated image, boot the L16 onto it, qualify, then apex-shell roadmap/v2.2 -> main FIRST (Containerfile.base carries ARG APEX_SHELL_REF=main), then apex-os roadmap/v2.2 -> main. This is the only point at which GitHub CI is allowed to run.
